# Scatter labels stay sparse unless you ask

Every row below is synthetic data for demonstrating label behaviour; none of it is a measurement. The first chart names 40 stations, and 34 of them sit almost on top of each other. RichView labels the isolated stations first, caps the names it attempts, and hides any name that would collide or need a leader line. The hidden names remain in the readouts, the table and the drop report.

## Sparse by default

title: Isolated stations carry their names, the packed cluster does not

## Highlight what matters

The second chart is also synthetic. Three towns sit in crowded clusters. `highlight` always attempts the named points first, matching case-insensitively. `priority` decides who gets the contested position when two highlights collide: Harbour Quay and Harbour Row are only a few pixels apart, so Harbour Quay, listed first, takes the nearest free spot and a crowded name such as Harbour Row may be joined to its point by a leader line. Ordinary names such as Tidewater are hidden instead.

```chart
type: scatter
title: Named towns are labelled even inside a crowd
subtitle: Highlighted points are placed first, in priority order; only a crowded highlight gets a leader
data:
  inline:
    - { place: Harbour Quay, region: coast, effort_index: 41.2, reach_index: 38.1 }
    - { place: Harbour Row, region: coast, effort_index: 41.9, reach_index: 38.6 }
    - { place: Harbour Steps, region: coast, effort_index: 42.4, reach_index: 37.7 }
    - { place: Tidewater, region: coast, effort_index: 44.1, reach_index: 40.0 }
    - { place: Saltmarsh, region: coast, effort_index: 18.5, reach_index: 25.4 }
    - { place: Mill Lane, region: valley, effort_index: 55.3, reach_index: 52.2 }
    - { place: Mill Yard, region: valley, effort_index: 55.9, reach_index: 52.8 }
    - { place: Mill Race, region: valley, effort_index: 56.4, reach_index: 52.0 }
    - { place: Weir End, region: valley, effort_index: 57.3, reach_index: 53.6 }
    - { place: Ford Meadow, region: valley, effort_index: 70.2, reach_index: 66.1 }
    - { place: Orchard Gate, region: valley, effort_index: 33.0, reach_index: 61.4 }
    - { place: Ridge Top, region: upland, effort_index: 81.2, reach_index: 81.5 }
    - { place: Ridge Cross, region: upland, effort_index: 81.9, reach_index: 82.1 }
    - { place: Cairn Hill, region: upland, effort_index: 86.4, reach_index: 74.9 }
    - { place: Heather Fold, region: upland, effort_index: 64.7, reach_index: 88.3 }
    - { place: Stone Gap, region: upland, effort_index: 90.1, reach_index: 90.4 }
    - { place: Bleak Edge, region: upland, effort_index: 12.9, reach_index: 84.2 }
    - { place: Lark Rise, region: upland, effort_index: 47.5, reach_index: 90.0 }
encoding:
  x: effort_index
  y: reach_index
  color: region
  label: place
highlight:
  by: place
  include: [harbour row, Harbour Quay, MILL YARD, Ridge Cross, Stone Gap]
  priority: [Harbour Quay, Harbour Row]
axes:
  x: {label: Effort index}
  y: {label: Reach index}
```
